criterion_text: After an authenticated Relay attach, a deliberately half-open Agent leg that neither closes nor responds is detected and retired **within a documented finite bound**; an explicit Relay-end/error reason is observable by the client. A healthy but idle Agent leg remains connected and usable.

verifiers.summary: Authenticated Relay silent Agent-leg partition triggers a bounded, explicit client-visible close and leaves the Session reattachable

evidence.value: 8aa891aa91b8ae61e76dd8d6434fb934324c67e6: real Server Relay over authenticated Agent-facing socket received no pong/terminal data after attach and emitted WebSocket close reason relay-agent-half-open within the bounded idle watchdog (elapsed >=35s); the persisted Session survived and a replacement browser reattached and forwarded exactly one terminal-input frame

verifiers.summary: A responsive idle Agent leg survives the full 45s watchdog and resumes terminal input

evidence.value: 8aa891aa91b8ae61e76dd8d6434fb934324c67e6: a separate live Agent with active pong processing remained connected through a 51s idle window beyond the 45s watchdog and forwarded terminal input afterwards
